record.question: What is the position of India in the 2019 Ease of Doing Business rankings?
record.explanation: Answer C: 63rd. The World Bank Doing Business 2020 profile, released in 2019, gives India rank 63. This question is about that 2019 release, not the later discontinued/currently unavailable ranking series. Reference: https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/636621574941404453/pdf/Doing-Business-2020-Comparing-Business-Regulation-in-190-Economies-Economy-Profile-of-India.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
